title: Smart TV owners use AI to remove ads and bloatware
excerpt: Frustrated by ads and slow interfaces, smart TV owners are using AI agents to strip away bloatware and regain control.
body_html:
A growing number of smart television owners are utilizing artificial intelligence to remove bloatware and streamline their viewing devices. Frustrated by sluggish user interfaces, intrusive advertisements, and ongoing tracking, users are deploying AI agents to strip away unwanted software features.

This trend highlights rising consumer dissatisfaction with the built-in operating systems of modern connected televisions. By taking matters into their own hands with AI tools, these owners are working to reclaim control over their home entertainment hardware and simplify their user experience.
